I farm here in Arusha and the soil is still good from the mountain, so maize grows well if the masika rains come proper. I have 3.52 hectares which is bigger than most of my neighbors, and since I own this land I want to put some fertilizer to get a better harvest — last season I used DAP at planting and a little urea for topdressing and it paid off. I cannot afford to fertilize every corner of the plot like the big farms do, but I will buy maybe four or five bags total and spread them where the maize looks weak. I keep a few cattle so I also carry manure to the plot before the rains, and I buy improved seed from the agro-dealer in town because the local seed does not yield enough on a plot this size.
